_about: Public-domain Phillips Brooks (1835-1893, rector of Trinity Church, Boston, then Episcopal Bishop of Massachusetts) for the Word Hoard: the Yale Lectures on Preaching (1877) and three volumes of his sermons (first series, catalogued 1878; eighth series, New Starts in Life, 1896; tenth series, Seeking Life, 1904) as raw Internet Archive OCR, and his Addresses clean from Project Gutenberg (rights line checked by the fetcher). Added 2026-10-03 by lane A, round 12 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

pbrooks-addresses: Addresses by the Right Reverend Phillips Brooks

pbrooks-lectures-preaching-1877: Lectures on Preaching, delivered before the Divinity School of Yale College in January and February, 1877 (New York: E. P. Dutton, 1877)
pbrooks-sermons-1: Sermons (first series; New York: E. P. Dutton; no date on the title page, catalogued 1878)
pbrooks-new-starts-1896: New Starts in Life, and Other Sermons, eighth series (New York: E. P. Dutton, 1896)
pbrooks-seeking-life-1904: Seeking Life, and Other Sermons, tenth series (New York: E. P. Dutton, 1904)
